incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 5xx rate in us-west-2 for model-serving runtime. 5m error rate 6.2% (baseline ~0.1%). Trigger: repeated segfaults / OOM in model-runner processes. Starting triage thread. thread_ts=1769832100

Tasha: I'm on it. pulling traces and which customers hit errors. anyone oncall for runtime? @mike?

Mike: here. seeing a cluster of crashes from the new quantized runner on gpu-pool-usw2-3 around 1769832050. stacklooks like `segfault` inside attention kernel when handling long contexts.

Jon: logs incoming to splunk: sample snippet:
```
[2026-04-02T15:35:45Z] model-runner[pid=4421] ERROR signal 11 (SIGSEGV) ip=0x7f2c1b2f pc=0x7f2c1b2f
[2026-04-02T15:35:45Z] model-runner[pid=4421] backtrace: attention_kernel+0x1f4
[2026-04-02T15:35:45Z] system: GPU memory spike, oom_killer invoked for process 4421
```

Irene: Customer-facing metrics show two customers (acme-inc, quickchat) with elevated 5xx. Sam + CS loop?

Sam: pinged both; acme-inc seeing ~15% failed requests in last 10m, quickchat ~9%. I've posted initial postmortem nudge.

Tasha: mitigation idea: 1) route traffic away from quantized model variant to fp16 variant 2) temporarily disable long-context route (clip requests > 8k tokens) 3) scale up worker pool in another AZ. Thoughts?

Mike: agree. quick hotfix plan: change routing policy -> fallback to model-v2-fp16 when model-v2-quant returns 5xx. That can be pushed via routing config and doesn't need a code deploy.

deploy-bot: routing-change request queued: PATCH /routing/policies/serve-fallback -> set fallback=model-v2-fp16 for model-v2-quant. (req-id 8f3b2c)

Jon: also seeing kv-cache pressure: prefix cache for long-context requests is growing and causing larger allocations. We should enable kv-cache eviction threshold lower for quant runner. config path: `/etc/model-runner/kvcache.conf`

Mike: reducing kv cache from 4GB -> 1.2GB on the quant pool now via remotectl. running command:
```
remotectl --pool gpu-pool-usw2-3 set-config kv_cache_limit=1.2G
```

Tasha: I've applied a temporary ingress rule to reject requests with content-length > 2MB at the gateway for the affected model route to limit pathological long contexts.

Irene: scaling actions: spinning up 4 extra fp16 workers in us-west-2b to absorb redirected traffic. ETA ~90s.

Jon: core dumps are being captured. attaching instructions for debug:
```
sudo systemctl stop model-runner
ulimit -c unlimited
echo '/tmp/core.%e.%p' > /proc/sys/kernel/core_pattern
sudo systemctl start model-runner --debug-collect
```

Mike: idx of failing request patterns: large batched chat requests with mix of function-calls + long system prompt. Suspect attention kernel regression with mixed inputs + quant path.

Tasha: monitoring: 5xx dropped from 6.2% -> 1.8% after routing fallback and kv-cache limit. still elevated but improving. customer impact reduced.

Sam: acme-inc confirmed drop from 15% -> 3% failures. quickchat reported recovery to ~1.5%. sending update to both.

Jon: stack traces from core dump show `attempt to read from freed memory` inside `kv_cache::retrieve_shard`. attaching minimal trace snippet:
```
#0  0x00007f2c1b2f in attention_kernel (args=0x7fff...) at kernels/attention.cu:423
#1  0x00007f2c0ab4 in run_attention (ctx=0x...) at runner/forward.cc:812
#2  0x00007f2c0b3d in process_batch (..) at runner/serve.cc:120
```

Mike: plan for next 30m: 1) keep fallback routing enabled, 2) keep kv-cache limit lower, 3) collect full core dumps and perf traces, 4) disable quantized runner autoscale to stop creating new quant workers. I'll prepare a PR to revert the recent quantization kernel change if traces confirm.

Irene: notifying legal/security & SRE about possible PII in core dumps. using scrubbing config before upload.

Tasha: quickie customer impact summary for handoff:
- incident start: 2026-04-02T15:35:45Z (thread_ts 1769832100)
- primary cause: quantized attention kernel regression causing segfaults + OOM under long-context workloads
- scope: us-west-2 region, ~2.4k requests/min affected at peak, customers impacted: acme-inc (high), quickchat (med), several smaller PLG tenants (low)
- mitigation applied: routing fallback to fp16, kv-cache limit reduced, ingress long-context throttle, extra fp16 workers, disabled quant autoscale
- current status: partial mitigation; error rate reduced to 1.8% across region, customer failures mostly resolved pending debug
- next steps: capture full traces + cores, reproduce in staging with long-context replay, revert quant kernel patch if confirmed, release hotfix + canary

Tasha: handing to @aisha for next shift. please pick up at 2026-04-02T16:05Z. notes above + links to cores in secure bucket.

Aisha: ack. I'll take over. immediate action on my list: validate core scrubbing, continue redirect until hotfix, coordinate with Mike on PR review. will update every 15m.

Mike: created issue #INF-4721 with logs, cores, and steps-to-repro. linking reproducer here: https://ci.replay/inf-4721/repro-playback

Tasha: thanks team. marking pager as acknowledged. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: Pager note: on-call handoff recorded, next_oncall=aisha, handoff_ts=1769832385
